purpose: Evidence for the project owner to sign off, or not, on nine candidate events for Milestone 2 step 3 (batch 4 of 6, the next candidates of the 33 that remained after batches 1-3; earlier packets said 'of 7' on an assumed smaller batch size -- at 11 per batch it is 6). Nothing here is an acceptance: each event stays quarantined, and no label is computed, until the corresponding attestations are added.
how_candidates_were_chosen: Batch 4 is the next 11 candidates by filing date after batches 1-3 (HURN 2025-02-25 through TECX 2025-03-20). Two of the 11 are excluded (reports/m2-step3-batch4-eligibility-review-2026-10-02.json): ALKT 2025-02-27 under the project's own same-day competing-catalyst policy (a separate PRNewswire release for a $400 million acquisition went out in the same displayed minute as the earnings release -- all three conditions hold, the same case as Milestone 1's MEI) and REKR 2025-03-17 as an explicit preliminary pre-announcement (self-labelled 'preliminary and unaudited', with a CEO resignation in the same release) -- leaving 9 genuine candidates built here. The ALKT exclusion is a policy judgment the owner may disagree with; see what_a_sign_off_would_look_like.

what_a_sign_off_would_look_like: For example: 'sign off on all nine', or a list of event_ids/decisions -- including, if you would rather, a decision to include ALKT 2025-02-27 with a caveat instead of excluding it (it would then be built as a tenth event of this batch). Then the attestations are added for the signed-off candidates, the workflow runs for real, and each result is recorded with a pinned label digest.
not_a_claim: Not evidence of any predictive edge.

Not a claim that any proposed_label_caveat's underlying item is or is not disqualifying -- each read item is described, none is resolved here, and they travel with the computed labels (config/m2-step3-events.json carries them).

Chronology is built from each issuer's 8-K filing history plus targeted web searches; other SEC forms (prospectus supplements, Schedule 13D/G, Form 4) and press releases that never became an 8-K are not swept -- the same residual gap as batches 1-3.
Prior-quarter identity for the eight chain-anchored issuers is compared against the cover row recorded in each issuer's own earlier packet, not re-fetched; HURN's prior cover was read directly.
